source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 2 exercise solved (PDF 51-53), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Force and Motion) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai (kitab MCQs ki key nahi deti); short, wazahati aur tafseeli sawalon ke model jawab aur numericals ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
2.1 The angle at which dot product becomes equal to cross product:
(Kis angle par dot product cross product ke barabar ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: AB cos θ = AB sin θ se tan θ = 1, is liye θ = 45°.

blocks.prompt:
2.2 The projectile gains its maximum height at an angle of:
(Projectile sab se zyada unchai kis angle par hasil karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unchai h = vi² sin²θ / 2g sab se zyada tab hai jab sin θ = 1, yani θ = 90° (seedha oopar phenkna).

blocks.prompt:
2.3 The scalar product of two vector is maximum if they are:
(Do vectors ka scalar product kab sab se zyada hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: A.B = AB cos θ sab se zyada tab hai jab cos θ = 1 (θ = 0°), yani parallel vectors ke liye: A.B = AB.

blocks.prompt:
2.4 The range of projectile is same for two angles which are mutually:
(Projectile ki range do aise angles ke liye barabar hoti hai jo aapas mein:)
blocks.explanation: R = vi² sin 2θ / g, aur sin 2(90° - θ) = sin (180° - 2θ) = sin 2θ. Is liye complementary angles (θ aur 90° - θ, maslan 30° aur 60°) ki range barabar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.5 The acceleration at the top of a trajectory of projectile is:
(Projectile ke raaste ki choti par acceleration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choti par vertical velocity sifar hai, magar gravity ab bhi lagti hai, is liye acceleration g (9.8 m s⁻², neeche ki taraf) hai, raaste ke har nuqte par.

blocks.prompt:
2.6 SI unit of impulse is:
(Impulse ka SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Impulse = F × t, is liye unit newton second (N s) hai, jo kg m s⁻¹ (momentum ka unit) ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.7 The rate of change of momentum is:
(Momentum mein tabdeeli ki sharah (rate) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Momentum ki shakal mein Newton ka doosra qanoon: momentum mein tabdeeli ki sharah lagne wali force ke barabar hai, F = (mvf - mvi)/t.

blocks.prompt:
2.8 As rocket moves upward during its journey, then its acceleration goes on:
(Rocket jab oopar jata hai to us ki acceleration:)
blocks.explanation: a = mv/M. Fuel jal kar nikalta hai to rocket ki mass M kam hoti hai, is liye acceleration barhti hai (2.12).

blocks.prompt:
2.9 Elastic collision involves:
(Elastic collision mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: na energy ka izafa, na nuqsan
energy aur elastic collision ka koi talluq nahi

blocks.explanation: Perfectly elastic collision mein koi kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti: takkar se pehle aur baad kul K.E. (aur momentum) barabar rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.1 State right hand rule for two vectors w.r.t. vector product.
(Vector product ke liye do vectors ka right hand rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
A aur B ki dumein (tails) aik jagah milayein. Pehle vector A ko chhote angle se B ki taraf ghumayein aur seedhe haath ki ungliyan isi gardish ki taraf morein, angootha khara rakhein.
Khara angootha A × B ki simt (direction) batata hai, jo A aur B ke plane par amoodi hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.2 Define impulse and show how it is related to momentum.
(Impulse ki tareef karein aur dikhayein ke yeh momentum se kaise juda hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Impulse average force F aur us ke lagne ke waqt t ka hasil-e-zarb hai: Impulse = F × t (unit N s).
Newton ke doosre qanoon se F = (mvf - mvi)/t, is liye F × t = mvf - mvi.
Impulse = momentum mein tabdeeli.

blocks.prompt:
2.3 Differentiate between an elastic and an inelastic collision.
(Elastic aur inelastic collision mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein momentum aur kul energy mehfooz (conserved) rehti hai; farq yeh hai ke kinetic energy mehfooz rehti hai ya nahi.

rows: System ki kinetic energy mehfooz rehti hai
System ki kinetic energy mehfooz nahi rehti
Takkar mein koi K.E. zaya nahi hoti
K.E. ka kuch hissa heat, sound aur shakal bigarne mein badal jata hai
Takkar ke baad jism alag ho jaate hain
Jism aapas mein chipak sakte hain (perfectly inelastic)
Misal: sakht gaind marble ke farsh par gir kar taqreeban usi unchai tak uchhalti hai
Misal: lakri ke block mein goli; tennis gaindon ki takkar

blocks.prompt:
2.4 Show that rate of change in momentum is equal to force applied. Also state Newton's second law of motion in terms of momentum.
(Dikhayein ke momentum mein tabdeeli ki sharah lagai gayi force ke barabar hai. Newton ka doosra qanoon momentum ki shakal mein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Force F mass m par waqt t tak lagti hai aur velocity vi se vf ho jaati hai: a = (vf - vi)/t aur Newton ke doosre qanoon se a = F/m.
Is liye F/m = (vf - vi)/t, ya F = (mvf - mvi)/t: force = momentum mein tabdeeli ki sharah.
Newton ka doosra qanoon: kisi jism ke momentum mein tabdeeli ki sharah lagne wali force ke barabar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.5 State law of conservation of linear momentum. Also state condition under which it holds.
(Linear momentum ke conservation ka qanoon bayan karein aur woh shart bhi jis mein yeh laagu hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Qanoon: aik isolated (alag thalag) system ka kul linear momentum aik jaisa (constant) rehta hai, yani m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′.
Shart: system isolated ho: us par koi bairooni (external) force na lage (sirf andar ki action-reaction forces jo aik doosre ko khatam karti hain).

blocks.prompt:
2.6 Show that range of projectile is maximum at an angle of 45°.
(Dikhayein ke projectile ki range 45° par sab se zyada hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Range R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ. Diye gaye vi ke liye R sab se zyada tab hai jab sin 2θ = 1 (us ki sab se bari qeemat).
Is liye 2θ = 90°, ya θ = 45°, aur Rmax = vi²/g.

blocks.prompt:
2.7 Find the time of flight of a projectile to reach the maximum height.
(Projectile ko sab se zyada unchai tak pohanchne ka waqt maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se zyada unchai par vertical velocity sifar ho jaati hai: vfy = vi sin θ - gt = 0.
Is liye t = vi sin θ / g, jo kul time of flight T = 2vi sin θ / g ka aadha hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.8 The maximum horizontal range of a projectile is 800 m. Find the value of height attained by the projectile at θ = 60°.
(Projectile ki sab se zyada horizontal range 800 m hai. θ = 60° par us ki unchai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rmax = vi²/g = 800 m, is liye vi² = 800 m × g.
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g = (800 m × g)(sin 60°)² / 2g = 800 m × 0.75 / 2
h = 300 m

blocks.prompt:
2.1 Why does a hunter aiming a bird in a tree miss the target exactly at the bird?
(Darakht par baithe parinde ka seedha nishana lene wala shikari kyun chook jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Goli bandooq se nikalte hi projectile ban jaati hai. Woh aage yaksaan horizontal velocity se chalti hai, magar saath hi gravity use neeche kheenchti hai (neeche girna y = ½gt²).
Is liye woh nishane ki seedhi line se neeche gir kar parinde ke neeche se guzar jaati hai, jab ke parinda wahin hai. Lagane ke liye shikari ko parinde se thora oopar nishana lena chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
2.2 A person falling on a heap of sand does not hurt more as compared to a person falling on a concrete floor. Why?
(Ret ke dher par girne wale ko pakke (concrete) farsh par girne wale se kam chot kyun lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Dono suraton mein insaan ka momentum utna hi badalta hai (mv se sifar), aur F × t = momentum mein tabdeeli.
Ret dab jaati hai, is liye insaan zyada waqt t mein rukta hai aur jism par force F = Δp/t kam hoti hai.
Concrete insaan ko foran rok deta hai (bohat chhota t), is liye force bohat zyada hoti hai aur chot zyada lagti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahi wajah hai ke helmet mein padding aur gaariyon mein crumple zone hote hain: takkar ka waqt barhao, force ghatao.

blocks.prompt:
2.3 State the conditions under which birds fly in air.
(Woh sharait bayan karein jin mein parinde hawa mein urte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Parinda par maarta hai aur hawa ko neeche aur peeche dhakelta hai; Newton ke teesre qanoon (momentum conservation) se hawa parinde ko oopar aur aage dhakelti hai.
Sharait:
1. Hawa maujood ho jis ko par dhakel saken (khala (vacuum) mein parinda nahi ur sakta).
2. Hawa ka oopar ka dhakka (lift) parinde ke wazan ke barabar ya zyada ho.
3. Aage ka dhakka (thrust) hawa ki rukawat (drag) par ghalib aaye.
(chapter se bahar: chapter mein urne ka bayan nahi.)

blocks.prompt:
2.4 Describe the circumstances for which velocity and acceleration of a vehicle are:
(i) v is zero but a is not zero
(ii) a is zero but v is not zero
(iii) perpendicular to one another
(Woh halaat bataein jin mein gaari ki velocity aur acceleration: (i) v sifar magar a sifar nahi (ii) a sifar magar v sifar nahi (iii) aik doosre par amoodi hon.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) v = 0, a ≠ 0: gaari jis lamhe rukne ki halat se chalna shuru kare (ya jis lamhe simt ulte); isi tarah oopar phenke jism ki choti par v = 0 magar a = g.
(ii) a = 0, v ≠ 0: gaari yaksaan velocity se chal rahi ho (seedhi line mein aik jaisi speed).
(iii) v ⊥ a: gaari gol track par aik jaisi speed se mur rahi ho: velocity tangent ke saath aur acceleration markaz (centre) ki taraf.

blocks.prompt:
2.5 Describe briefly effects of air resistance on the range of a projectile.
(Projectile ki range par hawa ki rukawat (air resistance) ke asraat mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hawa ki rukawat projectile ki aage ki harkat ko dheema karti hai aur velocity ghatati hai, is liye us ki range (aur unchai) kam ho jaati hai.
Hawa ki rukawat aik jaisi nahi rehti: projectile dheema hota hai to yeh bhi kam hoti hai. Is liye raasta poora parabola nahi rehta balke tircha (skewed) ho jata hai, utarna charhne se zyada dhalwan wala, aur ideal parabolic raaste se chhota reh jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.1 Define and explain scalar product. Write down its important characteristics.
(Scalar product ki tareef aur wazahat karein. Is ki aham khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: agar do vectors ka hasil-e-zarb scalar quantity ho to use scalar (dot) product kehte hain:
A.B = AB cos θ
jahan A aur B vectors ki magnitudes aur θ un ke darmiyan angle hai.
Wazahat: A aur B ko aik hi origin par layein. Phir
A.B = A (B ka A par projection) = A (B cos θ) = AB cos θ
Isi tarah B.A = B (A cos θ) = BA cos θ.
Misal: force F apne point ko d faasle tak θ angle par le jaye to work: W = (F cos θ) d = F.d.
Khususiyaat:
1. Commutative: A.B = B.A (tarteeb se farq nahi parta).
2. Amoodi (perpendicular) vectors (θ = 90°): A.B = AB cos 90° = 0.
3. Parallel vectors (θ = 0°): A.B = AB (sab se zyada); antiparallel (θ = 180°): A.B = -AB.
4. Self product: A.A = A².
5. Rectangular components mein: A.B = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz.
6. Do vectors ka darmiyani angle: cos θ = (AxBx + AyBy + AzBz)/AB.

blocks.prompt:
2.2 Define and explain vector product of two vectors. Discuss important characteristic of vector product.
(Do vectors ke vector product ki tareef aur wazahat karein. Is ki aham khususiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: agar do vectors ka hasil-e-zarb vector quantity ho to use vector (cross) product kehte hain:
A × B = AB sin θ n̂
jahan θ A aur B ka darmiyani angle aur n̂ A aur B wale plane par amoodi unit vector hai.
Simt (right hand rule): A aur B ki dumein milayein, A ko chhote angle se B ki taraf ghumayein aur seedhe haath ki ungliyan usi taraf morein; khara angootha A × B ki simt batata hai. Is liye B × A, A × B ke ulat hai.
Khususiyaat:
1. Non-commutative: A × B ≠ B × A; balke A × B = -B × A.
2. Amoodi vectors (θ = 90°): magnitude sab se zyada, A × B = AB n̂.
3. Parallel ya antiparallel vectors (θ = 0° ya 180°): A × B = 0 (null vector); is liye A × A = 0.
4. A × B ki magnitude us parallelogram ke area ke barabar hai jis ke saath wale sides A aur B hon.
Misalein:
Torque: τ = r × F
Magnetic field B mein velocity v se chalte charge q par force: F = q(v × B)

blocks.prompt:
2.3 Derive three equations of motion by graphical method.
(Graph ke tareeqe se harkat (motion) ki teen equations derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Velocity-time graph: jism yaksaan acceleration a se chalta hai; us ki velocity waqt t mein vi (nuqta A, OA = vi) se vf (nuqta B) ho jaati hai. B se time axis par amood BD (BD = vf, OD = t) aur A se time axis ke mutawazi AC banayein jo BD se C par mile (AC = OD = t, CD = OA = vi). AB seedhi line hai.
Pehli equation (vf = vi + at):
BD = BC + CD = BC + OA, is liye vf = BC + vi ...... (1)
AB ka slope = acceleration: a = BC/AC = BC/t, is liye BC = at ...... (2)
(1) aur (2) se: vf = vi + at
Doosri equation (S = vit + ½at²):
Faasla S = graph ke neeche area OABD = rectangle OACD ka area + triangle ABC ka area
S = (OA × OD) + ½(AC × BC) = vi t + ½(t × at)
S = vit + ½at²
Teesri equation (2aS = vf² - vi²):
S = trapezium OABD ka area = ½(mutawazi sides ka majmua) × unchai = ½(OA + BD) × OD
S = ½(vi + vf) t
Pehli equation se t = (vf - vi)/a, is liye
S = ½(vf + vi)(vf - vi)/a
2aS = vf² - vi²
Yeh equations sirf seedhi line mein yaksaan acceleration wali harkat par laagu hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Exam mein pehle velocity-time graph banayein: time x-axis par, velocity y-axis par; A (0, vi) se B (t, vf) tak seedhi line; B se neeche D, A se seedhi line C tak. Har equation ke liye: pehli = slope, doosri = rectangle + triangle ka area, teesri = trapezium ka area.

blocks.prompt:
2.4 What is projectile motion? Explain.
(Projectile motion kya hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: projectile motion gravity ki yaksaan acceleration ke tehat do-dimensional harkat hai. Misalein: player ki kik se football, cricketer ki phenki gaind, launching pad se chalaya missile.
Wazahat: harkat ko horizontal aur vertical components mein torte hain, jo aik doosre se aazad hain.
Projectile ko velocity vi se horizontal ke saath angle θ par phenka jaye to components vix = vi cos θ aur viy = vi sin θ hain.
Horizontal harkat: hawa ki rukawat chhor kar koi horizontal force nahi, is liye ax = 0 aur horizontal velocity constant:
vfx = vix = vi cos θ, aur horizontal faasla x = vix t
Vertical harkat: gravity neeche lagti hai, is liye ay = -g (oopar ko positive):
vfy = vi sin θ - gt
Kisi bhi lamhe velocity: v = √(vfx² + vfy²), horizontal se angle φ, tan φ = vfy/vfx.
Unchai se horizontal phenki gaind: x = vx t aur woh y = ½gt² girti hai, free fall ki tarah.
Projectile ka raasta parabola hai. Is ki unchai, time of flight aur range:
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g, T = 2vi sin θ / g, R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ (θ = 45° par sab se zyada).

blocks.prompt:
2.5 Derive the following expressions for projectile motion:
(i) time of flight
(ii) height attained
(iii) range for projectile.
(Projectile motion ke liye yeh expressions derive karein: (i) time of flight (ii) unchai (iii) range.)
blocks.explanation:
Projectile velocity vi se horizontal ke saath angle θ par phenka gaya: vix = vi cos θ, viy = vi sin θ; vertical acceleration = -g, horizontal acceleration = 0.
(i) Time of flight (usi level par wapas aane ka waqt): vertical displacement S = 0.
S = viy t - ½gt²
0 = vi sin θ t - ½gt²
t = 2vi sin θ / g
(ii) Unchai: sab se ooncha nuqta par vfy = 0. 2aS = vf² - vi² mein a = -g, S = h:
-2gh = 0 - vi² sin²θ
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g
(iii) Range: horizontal velocity × time of flight
R = vix × t = vi cos θ × 2vi sin θ / g
R = (vi²/g) 2 sin θ cos θ
R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ
R sab se zyada tab hai jab sin 2θ = 1, yani θ = 45°: Rmax = vi²/g.

blocks.prompt:
2.6 Explain elastic collision in one dimension. Show that relative velocities before and after collision are the same.
(Aik dimension mein elastic collision ki wazahat karein. Dikhayein ke takkar se pehle aur baad relative velocities barabar hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Do hamwar, na ghoomne wali gaindein, masses m₁ aur m₂, aik hi seedhi line mein velocities v₁ aur v₂ (v₁ > v₂) se chalti hain. Elastic takkar ke baad usi line mein velocities v₁′ aur v₂′ se chalti hain. Daayein taraf ko positive lein.
Momentum ka conservation:
m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′
m₁(v₁ - v₁′) = m₂(v₂′ - v₂) ...... (1)
K.E. ka conservation (elastic collision):
½m₁v₁² + ½m₂v₂² = ½m₁v₁′² + ½m₂v₂′²
m₁(v₁² - v₁′²) = m₂(v₂′² - v₂²)
m₁(v₁ + v₁′)(v₁ - v₁′) = m₂(v₂′ + v₂)(v₂′ - v₂) ...... (2)
(2) ko (1) se taqseem karein:
v₁ + v₁′ = v₂′ + v₂
v₁ - v₂ = v₂′ - v₁′ = -(v₁′ - v₂′)
(v₁ - v₂) takkar se pehle pehli gaind ki doosri ke lihaz se velocity hai aur (v₁′ - v₂′) takkar ke baad. Dono ki magnitude barabar magar simt ulat hai: qareeb aane ki relative velocity = door jaane ki relative velocity.
(1) aur (2) hal karne se:
v₁′ = ((m₁ - m₂)/(m₁ + m₂))v₁ + (2m₂/(m₁ + m₂))v₂
v₂′ = (2m₁/(m₁ + m₂))v₁ + ((m₂ - m₁)/(m₁ + m₂))v₂
Khaas suratein: m₁ = m₂: gaindein velocities badal leti hain; m₁ = m₂, v₂ = 0: v₁′ = 0, v₂′ = v₁; halki gaind ruki bhaari gaind par: v₁′ = -v₁, v₂′ = 0; bhaari gaind ruki halki par: v₁′ ≈ v₁, v₂′ ≈ 2v₁.

blocks.prompt:
2.7 Derive the equations for momentum and energy conservation in a two dimensional collision.
(Do dimensions wali takkar mein momentum aur energy conservation ki equations derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik elastic tirchi (glancing, aamne saamne nahi) takkar lein. Projectile m₁ x-axis par velocity v₁i se chalta hai; target m₂ ruka hua hai (v₂i = 0). Takkar ke baad m₁ velocity v₁f se x-axis se oopar angle θ₁ par aur m₂ velocity v₂f se neeche angle θ₂ par jata hai.
Aakhri momentum ke components: m₁v₁f cos θ₁ aur m₁v₁f sin θ₁; m₂v₂f cos θ₂ aur m₂v₂f sin θ₂.
x-axis par momentum ka conservation (pehle ka momentum = baad ka momentum):
m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁i - m₁v₁f cos θ₁ = m₂v₂f cos θ₂ ...... (1)
y-axis par momentum ka conservation (shuru mein y-momentum sifar):
0 = m₁v₁f sin θ₁ - m₂v₂f sin θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂ ...... (2)
Kinetic energy ka conservation (elastic collision):
½m₁v₁i² = ½m₁v₁f² + ½m₂v₂f²
m₁v₁i² = m₁v₁f² + m₂v₂f² ...... (3)
Chaar na-maloom (v₁f, v₂f, θ₁, θ₂) hain; agar yeh naap liye jayein to equations (1), (2) aur (3) momentum aur energy ka conservation sabit karti hain. (Misal 2.9: 1 kg 5 m s⁻¹ se ruke 1 kg par: momentum 5 kg m s⁻¹ aur K.E. 12.5 J pehle bhi aur baad bhi.)

blocks.prompt:
2.8 Explain an inelastic collision in two dimension.
(Do dimensions mein inelastic collision ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Perfectly inelastic collision mein takrane wale jism aapas mein chipak jaate hain; momentum mehfooz rehta hai magar kinetic energy nahi.
Do jism m₁ aur m₂ xy-plane mein velocities v₁i (x-axis se angle θ₁) aur v₂i (angle θ₂) se chal kar origin par takrate hain. Takkar ke baad chipak jaate hain: mili hui mass M = m₁ + m₂, velocity vf se, x-axis se angle φ par.
x-direction mein momentum:
m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂ = M vf cos φ ...... (1)
y-direction mein momentum:
m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂ = M vf sin φ ...... (2)
Aakhri velocity ki magnitude ((1) aur (2) ka square kar ke jama):
vf = √([(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)/M]² + [(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/M]²)
Simt ((2) ko (1) se taqseem):
φ = tan⁻¹[(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)]
Kinetic energy (scalar hai, is liye velocities ke components nahi):
(K.E)i = ½m₁v₁i² + ½m₂v₂i², (K.E)f = ½M vf²
K.E. ka nuqsan = (K.E)i - (K.E)f; yeh energy heat, sound aur shakal bigarne mein badalti hai.
Misalein: karate chop se eentein torna, gaariyon ki takkar, bat se gaind ki takkar.

blocks.prompt:
2.1 The magnitude of cross and scalar products of two vectors are 4√3 and 4, respectively. Find the angle between the vectors. (Ans: 60°)
(Do vectors ke cross aur scalar product ki magnitudes 4√3 aur 4 hain. Vectors ka darmiyani angle maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: |A × B| = AB sin θ = 4√3, A.B = AB cos θ = 4
Maloom karna: θ
Taqseem karein: AB sin θ / AB cos θ = 4√3 / 4
tan θ = √3
θ = tan⁻¹(√3) = 60°
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.2 A helicopter is ascending vertically at the rate of 19.6 m s⁻¹. When it is at a height of 156.8 m above the ground, a stone is dropped. How long does the stone take to reach the ground? (Ans: 8.0 s)
(Helicopter 19.6 m s⁻¹ se seedha oopar ja raha hai. Zameen se 156.8 m unchai par us se pathar giraya jata hai. Pathar zameen tak kitne waqt mein pohanchega?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: girte waqt pathar ki velocity helicopter jaisi hai: vi = +19.6 m s⁻¹ (oopar positive), a = -g = -9.8 m s⁻², displacement S = -156.8 m (shuru ke nuqte se neeche)
Maloom karna: waqt t
S = vit + ½at²
-156.8 = 19.6 t - 4.9 t²
4.9 t² - 19.6 t - 156.8 = 0
4.9 se taqseem: t² - 4t - 32 = 0
(t - 8)(t + 4) = 0
t = 8.0 s (t = -4 s be-maani hai)
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ahem nuqta: helicopter se chhorne par pathar foran neeche nahi girta; us ki shuru ki velocity 19.6 m s⁻¹ oopar ki taraf hoti hai. Pehle 2 s oopar ja kar rukta hai, phir neeche aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.3 If |A+B| = |A-B|, then prove that A and B are perpendicular to each other. (Ans: θ = 90°)
(Agar |A+B| = |A-B| ho to sabit karein ke A aur B aik doosre par amoodi hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Farz karein A aur B ka darmiyani angle θ hai.
|A + B|² = (A + B).(A + B) = A² + B² + 2AB cos θ
|A - B|² = (A - B).(A - B) = A² + B² - 2AB cos θ
Diya gaya |A + B| = |A - B|, is liye
A² + B² + 2AB cos θ = A² + B² - 2AB cos θ
4AB cos θ = 0
cos θ = 0 (A aur B sifar nahi)
θ = 90°: A aur B amoodi hain.
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.4 A body of mass M at rest explodes into 3 pieces, two of which of mass M/4 each are thrown off in perpendicular directions with velocities of 3 m s⁻¹ and 4 m s⁻¹ respectively. Find the velocity of 3rd piece with which it will be flown away. (Ans: 2.5 m s⁻¹, opposite to resultant velocity vector of two pieces)
(Ruka hua M mass ka jism 3 tukron mein phat jata hai. M/4 mass ke do tukre amoodi simton mein 3 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ se urte hain. Teesre tukre ki velocity maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: shuru ka momentum = 0 (jism ruka hua); m₁ = m₂ = M/4, v₁ = 3 m s⁻¹, v₂ = 4 m s⁻¹ (amoodi)
Teesre tukre ki mass m₃ = M - M/4 - M/4 = M/2
Maloom karna: v₃
p₁ = (M/4)(3 m s⁻¹) = 0.75M; p₂ = (M/4)(4 m s⁻¹) = 1.0M
Dono tukron ka resultant momentum = √(p₁² + p₂²) = √(0.75² + 1.0²) M = 1.25M
Momentum ke conservation se kul momentum sifar rehta hai, is liye teesre tukre ka momentum 1.25M is resultant ke ulat hai:
m₃v₃ = 1.25M
(M/2) v₃ = 1.25M
v₃ = 2.5 m s⁻¹, do tukron ki resultant velocity ke ulat simt mein
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.6 A cricket ball is hit upward at an angle of 45° with velocity of 20 m s⁻¹. Find its:
(a) time of flight (b) maximum height (c) how far away it hits the ground
(Ans: 2.9 s, 41 m, 10.2 m)
(Cricket ki gaind 45° par 20 m s⁻¹ se oopar maari jaati hai. Maloom karein: (a) time of flight (b) sab se zyada unchai (c) kitni door zameen par girti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: vi = 20 m s⁻¹, θ = 45°, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
(a) Time of flight
t = 2vi sin θ / g = 2 × 20 m s⁻¹ × sin 45° / 9.8 m s⁻² = 28.28 / 9.8 s
t = 2.9 s
(b) Sab se zyada unchai
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g = (20 m s⁻¹)² × (sin 45°)² / (2 × 9.8 m s⁻²) = 400 × 0.5 / 19.6 m
h = 10.2 m
(c) Range (kitni door girti hai)
R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ = (20 m s⁻¹)² × sin 90° / 9.8 m s⁻² = 400 / 9.8 m
R = 40.8 m ≈ 41 m

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab (2.9 s, 41 m, 10.2 m) chhapti hai, yani (a), (b), (c) ki tarteeb mein. Magar sab se zyada unchai (b) 10.2 m aur range (c) 41 m hai; aakhri do jawab aik doosre ki jagah chhape hain.

blocks.prompt:
2.7 A 20 g ball hits the wall of a squash court with a constant force of 50 N. If the time of impact of force is 0.50 s, find the impulse. (Ans: 25 N s)
(20 g ki gaind squash court ki deewar se 50 N ki force se takrati hai. Takkar ka waqt 0.50 s ho to impulse maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: F = 50 N, t = 0.50 s (20 g mass ki zaroorat nahi)
Maloom karna: impulse I
I = F × t
I = 50 N × 0.50 s
I = 25 N s
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.8 A ball is kicked by a footballer. The average force on the ball is 240 N, and the impact lasts for a time interval of 0.25 s. Calculate:
(a) change in momentum
(b) state direction of change in momentum (the direction of change in momentum is the same as the direction of applied force, which is the direction, the footballer kicked the ball) (Ans: 60 N)
(Footballer gaind ko kik maarta hai. Gaind par average force 240 N aur takkar ka waqt 0.25 s hai. Maloom karein: (a) momentum mein tabdeeli (b) is tabdeeli ki simt.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: F = 240 N, t = 0.25 s
Maloom karna: momentum mein tabdeeli Δp aur us ki simt
(a) Δp = mvf - mvi = F × t
Δp = 240 N × 0.25 s
Δp = 60 N s = 60 kg m s⁻¹
(b) Momentum vector hai; momentum mein tabdeeli lagai gayi force ki simt mein hai, yani jis taraf footballer ne gaind ko kik maari.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab 60 N chhapti hai. Momentum mein tabdeeli = force × waqt = 240 N × 0.25 s = 60 N s (= 60 kg m s⁻¹); newton force ka unit hai, momentum ka nahi.

blocks.prompt:
2.9 An aeroplane moving horizontally at a speed of 200 m s⁻¹ at a height of 8 km to drop a bomb on a target. Find horizontal distance from the target should the bomb be released. (Ans: 8.08 km)
(Hawai jahaz 8 km ki unchai par 200 m s⁻¹ se horizontal ur raha hai aur nishane par bomb girana hai. Nishane se kitne horizontal faasle par bomb chhora jaye?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: vx = 200 m s⁻¹ (bomb ki horizontal velocity = jahaz ki velocity), shuru ki vertical velocity = 0, unchai y = 8 km = 8000 m, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Maloom karna: horizontal faasla x
Vertical harkat: y = ½gt²
t = √(2y/g) = √(2 × 8000 m / 9.8 m s⁻²) = √1632.7 s = 40.4 s
Horizontal harkat: x = vx × t
x = 200 m s⁻¹ × 40.4 s = 8081 m
x = 8.08 km
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bomb jahaz se chhoot kar bhi jahaz ki 200 m s⁻¹ wali horizontal velocity saath le jata hai (horizontal projectile). Is liye use nishane se pehle chhorna parta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2.10 Why does range of a projectile remain the same when angle of projection is changed from θ to θ′ = 90 - θ. Also show that for complementary angles of projection the ratio R/R′ is equal to 1.
(Projection ka angle θ se θ′ = 90 - θ karne par projectile ki range kyun nahi badalti? Yeh bhi dikhayein ke complementary angles ke liye R/R′ = 1 hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Range sin 2θ par munhasir hai, aur θ aur 90° - θ ke liye sin 2θ ki qeemat aik hi hai, is liye range wahi rehti hai.
R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ
R′ = (vi²/g) sin 2(90° - θ) = (vi²/g) sin (180° - 2θ) = (vi²/g) sin 2θ (kyunke sin (180° - x) = sin x)
R/R′ = sin 2θ / sin 2θ = 1
Misal: 30° aur 60° ki range barabar hai; bara angle zyada ooncha jata hai aur zyada der hawa mein rehta hai.

items: Kitab numerical 2.5 chhor deti hai (2.4 ke baad 2.6 aata hai).
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: numerical 2.6 mein unchai (10.2 m) aur range (41 m) ke jawab aik doosre ki jagah chhape hain; numerical 2.8 ka unit 60 N nahi, 60 N s hai.
